sentence: This project builds a planning framework that helps colleges and community colleges meet federal research security requirements.
This project builds a method that lets robots learn abstract representations of their environment and actions from experience.
This project studies how engineered nanoparticles in the air interact with the thin liquid film of lung surfactant.
This project studies a living reef system designed to protect shorelines, store carbon dioxide and restore oyster habitat.
This project builds text analysis techniques that spot emerging exploit trends in hacker forums and link exploits to vulnerabilities.
This project tests how well predictions match experimental data on the many shapes that RNA molecules take.
This project adds topological data analysis to modeling tools that predict wildfire activity, fire behavior and fire weather.
This project studies how light absorbed by metal particles is turned into electrical currents where the metal meets a semiconductor.
This project reads DNA from historic museum specimens to work out the evolutionary relationships among subspecies of the Sharp-tailed Grouse.
This project studies how axolotl salamanders regenerate limbs and how cells throughout the body are activated after amputation.
This project builds machine learning techniques that detect and locate misbehaving devices in wireless systems while preserving user privacy.
This project builds techniques that test and improve the robustness of deep natural language processing systems against adversarial attacks.
This project isolates bacteriophages, which are viruses that infect and kill bacteria, from soil and uses genome annotation to study them.
This project tries to find the genes that control how much floral nectar Aquilegia plants make and what it contains.
This project studies how high-intensity laser beams hitting dense plasma can produce bright, tunable extreme ultraviolet light.
This project builds a knowledge graph from online examples to model how people learn data visualization tools.
This project studies how interlocking granular materials deform and fail and builds computational models to design and analyze them.
This project builds laboratory activities and courses that teach artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.
